name: Grønland underganger
desc: Underganger og tekniske flater ved Grønland der tagging og gategrafikk preger byrommet.
popupDesc:
I overgangene mellom Grønland, Vaterland og kollektivknutepunktet finnes underganger, pilarer og vegger med tett lag av tags, paste-ups og markeringer. Her er uttrykkene ofte raske og midlertidige, men de skaper et tydelig visuelt språk for et område i konstant bevegelse.

Dette er subkultur i praksis: uformelle spor i et transitrom der mange passerer, få stopper, og nye lag stadig kommer til. Området viser hvordan gatekultur også lever i hverdagsinfrastruktur.
coordSource: OpenStreetMap way 163145627 – Olafiagangen; Kartverket SSR 998056 – Olafiagangen; Oslo kommune – Olafiagangen; Bydel Gamle Oslo – undergangene til Grønland T og området under Nylandsbrua
coordChangeReason: The unsupported editorial proxy is moved approximately 83.2 metres west to the deterministic half-length point of the named Olafiagangen pedestrian geometry. The radius is reduced from 210 to 130 metres because municipal sources now provide a finite public-space scope under Nylandsbrua and at the immediately connected Grønland T underpasses rather than a broad undefined Grønland/Vaterland environment.
coordNote: Oslo kommune describes Olafiagangen as a public passage and meeting place between Grønland torg and Akerselva directly under Nylandsbrua. Bydel Gamle Oslo explicitly treats the areas under Nylandsbrua and the underpasses to Grønland T as one physical improvement zone. OpenStreetMap way 163145627 and Kartverket SSR place 998056 independently identify Olafiagangen as a named linear object. The applied coordinate is the deterministic half-length point of the approximately 89.8-metre OSM pedestrian line. The two western Grønland T entrances lie approximately 25.7 and 19.5 metres from this point and are retained as secondary current-access anchors. The record therefore represents the Olafiagangen/Nylandsbrua passage and immediately connected T-bane transition zone; it does not claim that every graffiti wall, tunnel or technical surface across Grønland and Vaterland is inside one canonical geometry. One T-bane entrance under the bridge is planned to move by 2028, so entrance nodes are operational context rather than the stable primary identity.

accessContext.publicAccess: Olafiagangen is a public urban space managed by Oslo kommune. Current construction, T-bane operations, barriers, events, maintenance and safety measures can temporarily change access and circulation.
limitations: Use ordinary public pedestrian routes and respect temporary construction barriers, transit operations and municipal signs.
Do not enter technical rooms, service areas, track areas, closed passages or infrastructure spaces that are not publicly accessible.
Graffiti and paste-ups are transient surface evidence; their presence does not define the coordinate or guarantee that a particular work remains visible.
The 130-metre gameplay radius is not a property, road, bridge, station, construction or access boundary.
